block.title: Company Story
block.help: The film shown on the landing page. Paste a YouTube or Google Drive video link: it is changed to the embed link when you save. A Google Drive video plays only when the file is shared as Anyone with the link (Viewer), is a video file (MP4 recommended, not a folder or document) and Drive has finished processing it. Google may block a file watched a lot for a while (too many views), so YouTube (unlisted is fine) is the safer choice for this busy page. With Drive the visitor presses play twice, and a file larger than about 100 MB may not get a streamable preview.
